lines.text: Early Tony winners got a money clip.
The first Tony Awards dinner was on Easter Sunday in 1947.
lines.say: The first Tony Awards dinner was on Easter Sunday in nineteen forty seven.

lines.text: It was held in the Grand Ballroom of the Waldorf Astoria.
The awards are named for the actress and director Antoinette Perry.
For the first two years, there was no Tony statuette.
Every winner took home a scroll and a gift.
Men got a gold money clip or a cigarette lighter.
In 1949, a designers' union held a contest for a real Tony.
lines.say: In nineteen forty nine, a designers' union held a contest for a real Tony.

lines.text: Herman Rosse's medallion won, and it is still the Tony.

post.caption: Early Tony winners got a money clip. The first Tony Awards dinner was on Easter Sunday in 1947, in the Grand Ballroom of the Waldorf Astoria. For the first two years there was no Tony statuette. Every winner took home a scroll and a gift. Men got a gold money clip or a cigarette lighter, and women got an initialed compact. In 1949, a designers' union held a contest for a real Tony, and Herman Rosse's medallion won.
